packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once CI passes; a merged update to the plugin is released by auto-release.yml. Renovate merges itself, as master has no required checks for GitHub's auto-merge to wait for.
Require dashboard approval before opening major upgrade PRs.

Tombi comes from a branch of the kjanat/tombi fork with a portability delta, which is rebased onto each upstream release (see UPSTREAM.md and tombi-upstream.yml), not updated to the fork's latest commit.
